scope: Cancellable main-editor draft recovery and cheaper Lite snapshot preparation
before: On the previous runtime a delayed recovery disabled the KTP fields and exposed no cancellation button; the new regression test failed on the missing button
changes: Recovery GETs carry an AbortSignal; cancel and unmount abort the read and ignore late completion
Each recovery has its own identity so an old finalizer cannot unlock or replace a newer operation
Cancelled copies are not marked consumed and remain available after a later canonical save
Cancellation and failure restore keyboard focus; a collapsed copy list receives focus on its summary
Lite clones the compact wire payload and reconstructs the acknowledged snapshot using only a private immutable baseline plus copied edits
README removes obsolete test totals, clarifies mail-free registration, and records the prepared but unpublished hosting state

verification.legacyFirefox115: Actual ESR 115.40.0 passed compact KTP autosave, recovery, teacher approval and DOCX export on the current Windows host
verification.mobileAccessibility: 360 px, light/dark themes, axe checks on the recovery region; screenshots inspected
verification.largeKtp: Both editors preserve two separately edited rows during delayed autosave and retain all 2000 rows with the original canonical baseline unchanged

cpuExperiment.scope: Offline snapshot preparation and serialization only, excluding rendering, network and database

ci.configuration: Running main validations are retained; superseded feature/PR runs can still be cancelled
ci.limitation: YAML parsed locally; external CI completion is tracked separately and is not claimed by these local results

limitations: CPU throttling is not a physical Windows 7 or low-end school PC benchmark
Memory, PostgreSQL WAL and continuous-session load remain to be measured
No paid AI calls or public deployment in this batch
Heavy authenticated GET budgets remain a separate security audit item
